Project 1: To-Do Task Management Application (Project 1 GitHub Link)

Technologies Used: Salesforce Lightning Web Components (LWC), Apex, Salesforce Object Query Language (SOQL), JavaScript, CSS, HTML

Project Description: Developed a dynamic To-Do Task Management application on the Salesforce platform to enhance task tracking and management for users. The application allows users to manage tasks effectively by categorizing them into "Incomplete" and "Completed" sections, providing a seamless user experience through Salesforce Lightning Design System (SLDS).

Key Features Implemented:

  • Dynamic Data Loading: Utilized @wire service in LWC to load incomplete and completed task records from Salesforce, leveraging the loadAllIncompleteRecords and loadAllCompleteRecords Apex methods.
  • Real-Time Task Management: Enabled functionality for creating, updating, and deleting tasks directly from the user interface, ensuring real-time synchronization with Salesforce backend.
  • Drag-and-Drop Interface: Implemented drag-and-drop functionality for task elements, allowing users to move tasks between "To Do" and "Completed" lists.
  • Form Validation: Implemented client-side validation for task creation to prevent duplicate tasks and ensure required fields are filled.
  • Styling and User Interface: Applied custom styles using CSS to differentiate task statuses visually (incomplete tasks in antiquewhite and completed tasks in lightgreen).
  • Error Handling: Integrated robust error handling to manage exceptions and provide feedback to users through Salesforce toast notifications.

Achievements:

  • Successfully deployed the application within the Salesforce environment, enhancing task management efficiency.
  • Designed intuitive and responsive UI components.
  • Ensured data integrity and synchronization with backend services through effective use of Apex methods.

Technical Skills Demonstrated:

  • Proficiency in Salesforce Lightning Web Components (LWC) and Apex programming.
  • Implementation of SOQL queries and integration with Salesforce data objects.
  • Usage of Salesforce Lightning Design System (SLDS) for UI consistency.
  • Handling asynchronous data loading and state management in LWC.
  • Application of best practices in Salesforce development, including error handling and user notification mechanisms.


Project 2: Account Management Application (Project 2 GitHub Link)

Technologies Used: Salesforce Lightning Web Components (LWC), Apex, Salesforce Object Query Language (SOQL), JavaScript, CSS, HTML, Lightning Navigation Service, Salesforce Platform

Project Description: Developed an Account Management application within Salesforce, allowing users to create, edit, and delete account records efficiently. This application leverages the Lightning Web Components framework to provide a responsive and user-friendly interface for managing account details such as parent accounts, SLA expiration dates, SLA types, and more.

Key Features Implemented:

  • Dynamic Record Management: Implemented functionality to create new accounts, update existing accounts, and delete accounts based on user interactions.
  • Data Binding and Validation: Used LWC's data binding features to bind component properties to Salesforce data fields, ensuring real-time synchronization with Salesforce records. Integrated client-side validation to ensure data integrity and user input validation.
  • Interactive UI Components: Developed a form with various Salesforce Lightning components including lightning-combobox, lightning-input, lightning-radio-group, and lightning-slider to capture user inputs.
  • Apex Integration: Created multiple Apex methods to interact with Salesforce data, including retrieving parent account options, updating records, and managing account data based on business logic.
  • Conditional UI Rendering: Used conditional rendering techniques in LWC to show/hide UI elements based on the presence of specific data (e.g., visibility of delete button based on whether a record exists).
  • Navigation and Toast Notifications: Implemented navigation between record pages and toast notifications to provide feedback to users on actions taken within the application.

Achievements:

  • Successfully developed a comprehensive account management tool that improves user experience by providing an intuitive and interactive interface.
  • Streamlined the process of creating, editing, and managing account records directly within Salesforce.
  • Ensured compliance with data integrity and validation standards, contributing to the reliability of the application.

Technical Skills Demonstrated:

  • Proficiency in Salesforce Lightning Web Components (LWC) development, including handling events, data binding, and component lifecycle.
  • Expertise in Apex programming for backend operations, including SOQL queries and DML operations.
  • Effective use of Salesforce's Lightning Design System (SLDS) for UI consistency and responsiveness.
  • Implementation of validation and error handling mechanisms in client-side and server-side code.
  • Experience with Salesforce navigation services and user interface components for seamless user interactions.


Project 3: Contact Management Data Table with Custom Data Types (Project 3 GitHub Link)

Technologies Used: Salesforce Lightning Web Components (LWC), Apex, JavaScript, Salesforce Object Query Language (SOQL), CSS, HTML, Lightning Design System (SLDS)

Project Description: Led the development of a sophisticated Contact Management Data Table using Salesforce Lightning Web Components (LWC), incorporating custom data types to enhance data handling and interaction within Salesforce. This project facilitated efficient management of contact records, supporting CRUD operations in a responsive and user-friendly interface.

Key Features Implemented:

  • Custom Data Type Integration: Developed and integrated a custom data type component, c-custom-data-type, for the data table to handle dynamic data rendering and operations. This component facilitated flexible data structures and interactions tailored to specific business requirements.
  • Dynamic Data Table: Created a data table component that supports viewing, editing, and deleting contact records. It allows users to interact with the data through inline editing and action buttons, enhancing usability and efficiency.
  • CRUD Operations: Implemented Apex methods for creating, updating, and deleting contact records, using asynchronous programming patterns to ensure smooth and efficient data handling.
  • Conditional Rendering: Utilized conditional rendering in LWC to display data tables, modals, and action buttons based on user interactions, ensuring a seamless user experience.
  • Custom Modal Dialog: Designed a custom modal dialog for detailed record viewing and editing, improving the user interface for managing contact details effectively.
  • Data Validation and Error Handling: Integrated client-side validation and error handling mechanisms, providing immediate feedback to users through Salesforce's toast notifications.
  • Data Filtering: Added functionality to filter contacts based on various criteria, including lead source, enhancing data management capabilities for users.

Achievements:

  • Successfully developed a custom data type component to handle complex data interactions, significantly improving the data management capabilities of the application.
  • Enhanced user experience by implementing real-time data validations and updates, ensuring data integrity and responsiveness.
  • Streamlined record management processes by enabling efficient bulk operations, reducing the time and effort required for handling contact records.

Technical Skills Demonstrated:

  • Expertise in Salesforce Lightning Web Components (LWC) for building interactive and dynamic UI components.
  • Proficiency in Apex for backend operations, including CRUD operations and integration with Salesforce data models.
  • Implementation of asynchronous operations and robust error handling in JavaScript.
  • Experience with Salesforce's Lightning Design System (SLDS) for creating consistent and visually appealing user interfaces.
  • Understanding of Salesforce data models, custom datatypes to effectively manage and display data in the lightning datatables.


Project 4: Infinite Loading Data Table for Account Records (Project 4 GitHub Link)

Project Description: Developed an Infinite Loading Data Table using Salesforce Lightning Web Components (LWC) to enhance the user experience in viewing and managing Account records. This project implemented infinite scrolling to handle large datasets efficiently, ensuring seamless data loading and a responsive interface.

  • Conditional Rendering: Managed the display of loading indicators and data tables based on user interactions, enhancing the user experience.
  • Error Handling: Integrated robust error handling mechanisms to ensure smooth data retrieval and user notifications in case of issues.

Achievements:

  • Successfully implemented infinite loading, enabling users to interact with extensive datasets without encountering performance issues.
  • Enhanced user experience by providing real-time updates on the total records and the number of records loaded, ensuring transparency and data visibility.
  • Streamlined the process of loading additional data using efficient Apex methods, reducing server load and improving application responsiveness.

Technical Skills Demonstrated:

  • Expertise in Salesforce Lightning Web Components (LWC) for building interactive and dynamic UI components.
  • Proficiency in Apex for backend operations, including data retrieval and handling large datasets efficiently.
  • Implementation of asynchronous operations and robust error handling in JavaScript.
  • Experience with Salesforce's Lightning Design System (SLDS) for creating consistent and visually appealing user interfaces.
  • Understanding of Salesforce data models, particularly Accounts and related fields, to effectively manage and display data in the application.
